Olivia H: Morning 8:12am PT  Just received invoice INV-9001 from Aurora Analytics for $27,300. PDF has no PO and the vendor name on header is 'Aurora Analytics US' which doesn't exactly match Coupa record. Link: https://s3.company/aurora/INV-9001.pdf
Markus P: Coupa shows PO 130770 for Aurora (pilot analytics) but it's in APPROVED state with $10k remaining. PO vendor name is 'Aurora Analytics, Inc'.
Priya M: Policy: we need either the PO on the invoice or a vendor confirmation e-mail tying the invoice to PO 130770. For >$10k, Director approval is required if we do a manual match.
Olivia H: Line items show "analysis runtime" $17,300 + "professional services" $10,000. PS clearly ties to PO SOW. Runtime looks like overage not on PO. Can we match PS line and hold runtime?
Markus P: Yes we can match the $10k PS to PO 130770 if vendor confirms in writing. For the $17.3k runtime we need a separate billing path or a PO amendment.
Priya M: I'll email vendor: "Please reissue invoice with PO# 130770 on the PS line and indicate runtime as a separate invoice referencing contract SOW. Alternatively send written confirmation linking INV-9001 PS line to PO 130770."
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-9001 uploaded to NetSuite (NS-INV-19201). Status: "On Hold - PO Missing". Notified: finance-approvers.
Dana (CFO): If vendor confirms in writing and procurement approves the manual match for the $10k PS line, route to me for one-off Director sign-off. We won't pay the $17.3k runtime until it's properly documented.
Olivia H: Vendor replied: "We'll reissue two invoices within 48 hours: one for PS ($10k) with PO# 130770 and a separate runtime invoice. We'll CC finance@redwood."
Priya M: Perfect. I'll update NetSuite notes and prepare GL coding for both anticipated invoices. Marking this thread pending reissue.
Markus P: Once PS invoice is reissued with PO we can auto-match and route for approval. Leaving thread open until both invoices are posted. :white_check_mark:
